record_contract.clock: s_memrealtime with timer_hz for cross-CU alignment; local cycles require explicit anchors

conventions.collector: same-run rocprof-sys-run --rocm-events with raw PM counters in the same Perfetto proto as dispatch slices; rocprofv3 only as an explicitly labeled fallback/calibration
conventions.event_ids: Use event_id and event_id_const exactly as declared in configs/semantic_ids.json; never 0 and never assign a language-local sequence.
conventions.levels: Measure off, entry-only, and full builds; persistent-kernel PMC paths must fail closed if unsupported.
conventions.scope_selection: Use the enclosing task boundary to choose task versus phase; source keywords alone do not decide record_scope.
conventions.name_policy: display_name and trace name are the semantic_id; aliases are match-only and never rendered.
conventions.evidence_policy: This file is a reference library. Only an MI308X hard run can raise evidence_status to measured.
conventions.safety: Use FiBuf with n_slots = n_ctas * warps_per_cta, cap that includes OPEN/CLOSE and timer anchors, and overflow bits for lane-full or slot-out-of-range. Check wave < warps_per_cta, slot < n_slots, each write n < cap, and final overflow == 0 before delivery; do not silently drop or wrap a full wave lane.

event_boundaries.begin: Immediately before the first A/B tile load for the selected GEMM segment.
event_boundaries.end: After the final accumulator update and after any async MMA completion wait; the enclosing task span closes after the final C write or the selected segment boundary.

patterns.record_scope: task when the whole kernel segment is a GEMM; phase only when nested inside attention, MoE, convolution, or a fused operator. One span per executed GEMM segment, never one per K tile.
patterns.writer_rule: Exactly one writer per logical recorder. For FI_GRAN=0 compute linear_tid = threadIdx.x + blockDim.x * (threadIdx.y + blockDim.y * threadIdx.z), wave = linear_tid >> 6, and wave lane = linear_tid & 63; only wave lane 0 writes. For FI_GRAN=1 only linear_tid == 0 writes (group="cu"). Inside K-loops use FI_BG_PRED(fi_rec_k_, ev, aux) / FI_EG_PRED(fi_rec_k_, ev, aux) single-16B AoS global_store_dwordx4 with overflow atomicOr hoisted to fi_close. threadIdx.x alone is invalid for multidimensional blocks.
patterns.buffer_rule: Use FiBuf with n_slots = n_ctas * warps_per_cta, cap that includes OPEN/CLOSE and timer anchors, and overflow bits for lane-full or slot-out-of-range. Check wave < warps_per_cta, slot < n_slots, each write n < cap, and final overflow == 0 before delivery; do not silently drop or wrap a full wave lane.
language_notes: Target: MI308X is amd/gfx942 with wave64 (80 CUs, 4 XCCs); treat gfx942 as an explicit target, never as an NVIDIA fallback.
Size MFMA GEMM tiles to 128x128x16 across 4 wave64s (256 threads/CTA) so 2048x2048 launches 256 CTAs (<= 4 concurrent CTAs/CU on 80 CUs) instead of 4,096 tiny 32x32 CTAs.

FI_B/FI_E/FI_M and predicated FI_BG_PRED/FI_EG_PRED come from recorders/hip_cpp/fi_lite_hip.h, emitting single-16B AoS global_store_dwordx4 with s_memrealtime (100 MHz) ticks converted by the dump timer_hz and hoisted overflow atomicOr in fi_close.
For async global-to-LDS work, end load after the matching s_waitcnt or barrier; for MFMA, end after the completion wait.

Capture raw ROCm PM counters with same-run rocprof-sys-run --rocm-events and 12-buffer cold-HBM ring (As[12], Bs[12]), pairing counters to dispatch slices by same-dispatch timestamp and rendering topmost [0-100%] hardware utilization at pid=1 / upid=1 / sort_index=-1000; use rocprofv3 only as an explicit fallback/calibration. Persistent kernels must not use unsupported PMC paths.
